review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. CDFW enhanced status report and Smithsonian species account replace generic regulation citation; warm-SST recruitment evidence is qualitative, not a numeric preference curve.

profile.size: Min limit 14 inches TL / Bag limit 5 per harvester / day
profile.diet: Small fish, crustaceans, squids, and pelagic prey
profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for kelp bass.
factors.value_notes: CDFW's 2019 enhanced status report states that larval survival is highest during extended periods of warmer-than-average SST and that local temperature/current regimes influence recruitment. This supports SST as a relevant environmental factor, but does not identify a numeric adult or larval optimum and does not validate the configured 14-23 °C range or 16-21 °C ideal.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for kelp bass.
factors.value_notes: CDFW reports kelp bass from the surface to 46 m, most abundant at 2.7-21.3 m; FishBase reports most occurrence around 2.4-21 m. This supports the shallow 1-30 m habitat screen, but the configured 3-25 m ideal extends beyond the best-documented abundance band and is not a measured depth-preference curve.

text.day: Full daylight when Pacific gamefish actively hunt.

timing.note: West Coast captain reports and biological upwelling patterns.

regulations.summary: CDFW: 14" min TL; 5 per day combined
